notes.title: Root and Speed Mode
notes.notes:
You can now activate a speed mode for each level, as soon as you have found all available characters of a given day. This way, the levels stay more interesting if your only remaining goal is to beat the boss. To activate the speed mode, you have to enter the root, which appears near your base.

Also, all your stats are now visible at the level-up screen!
